title: Double Drip 10K Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Ice Prefilled Vape Pods + Refill
description: Designed for use with the Double Drip 10K Prefilled Pod Kit, this Pod & Refill Pack is the easiest way to keep your device topped up with a bold, fruity flavour. Each pack contains a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill bottle of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, delivering up to 10,000 puffs per kit (depending on use) with smooth, satisfying vapour. Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Ice is a vibrant medley of ripe Strawberries, tangy Raspberries and rich, dark Cherry, all finished with a clean, cooling wave of Menthol. It's a lively blend that balances berry sweetness with a crisp, icy twist. To refresh your flavour, simply insert the new pod and refill bottle and let the auto-refill mechanism handle the rest—no refilling, no coil swaps, no mess.
